name: Stage Flow
description: Where applications go: a flow through ordered stages (e.g. Responsible lending → … → Disbursed) where what leaves at each stage peels off, split by outcome (Rejected / Cancelled / In progress) with the reasons on hover; after the last stage, kept vs cancelled.

encodings.name: Stage
encodings.tooltip: The furthest stage each application reached (one row per application in your data). Order: Format Extension, or a rank field (e.g. MIN(furthest_rank)) on Detail.

encodings.name: Outcome
encodings.tooltip: How it ended, e.g. Disbursed / Rejected / Cancelled / In progress / Cancelled after disbursement.

encodings.name: Reason
encodings.tooltip: Optional. Reason and sub reason (e.g. reject_reason, reject_sub_reason): shown on hover over a leak.
